name: what-if-video
description: Vertical 'What if…' video in a PS2-style low-poly look: Remotion + React Three Fiber + three.js, with synthesized sound effects.

scripts.render: npm run sound && remotion render src/index.ts WhatIf out/video.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=192k
scripts.render:4k: npm run sound && remotion render src/index.ts WhatIf out/video-4k.mp4 --scale=2 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=256k
